definitions.explanation: Tableware designed for Japanese cuisine, including items such as rice bowls, soup bowls, small plates, and chopstick rests. Typically made of ceramics, lacquerware, or wood.

notes:
A compound of {和|わ} (Japanese-style) and ⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧ (tableware). Encompasses the full range of dishes and utensils used in Japanese cuisine. Japanese tableware is notable for its variety — unlike Western place settings where items match, Japanese meals typically feature an assortment of differently shaped and sized vessels chosen to complement each dish.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和食器|わしょっき}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: Japanese tableware set
- {和食器|わしょっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to collect Japanese tableware
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{和食器|わしょっき}: handmade Japanese tableware

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{洋食器|ようしょっき}→洋食器：24757_youshokki⟧: Western tableware — plates, forks, knives, etc.
- ⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧: tableware; dishes — general term covering both Japanese and Western styles
